contacts.name: Emergency (police, fire, medical)

contacts.name: Poison Control
contacts.notes: Free, confidential, 24/7. Connects to the Washington Poison Center.

contacts.name: Washington 211
contacts.notes: Community resources: shelter, food, utilities, disaster help.

contacts.name: Washington State Emergency Management Division
contacts.address: 20 Aviation Dr, Building 20, Camp Murray, WA 98430
contacts.notes: Part of WA Military Department. 800-562-6108 is the EMD Administration line. 24-hour State Alert & Warning Center: 800-258-5990. Mailing: MS TA-20, Camp Murray, WA 98430-5112.

contacts.name: Adams County Emergency Management
contacts.notes: County directory number; also listed as 'Co Main' in the EMD statewide list. No coordinates: Nominatim had no house-number match for this address (street-level results were rejected).

contacts.name: Asotin County Emergency Services
contacts.notes: Only a PO box is published, so there are no coordinates. The same phone appears in the EMD statewide list.

contacts.name: Benton County Emergency Services (Emergency Management)
contacts.notes: Phone from WA EMD Statewide EM Contact List dated 01 Nov 2026 (county site blocked automated access). 509-628-0333 is BCES's 24/7 non-emergency line; the EMD list also gives 509-628-2600. Franklin County has its own separate EM office (shared LEPC only).

contacts.name: Chelan County Emergency Management
contacts.notes: A division of the Chelan County Sheriff's Office, separate from Douglas County. Mailing: 401 Washington St #1, Wenatchee. The EMD list gives 509-667-6864 (the EM sergeant's line).

contacts.name: Clallam County Emergency Management
contacts.address: 223 E 4th St, Suite 12, Port Angeles, WA 98362
contacts.notes: Part of the Sheriff's Office. The county directory number differs from the EMD list, which gives staff lines 360-417-2570 and 360-417-2525.

contacts.name: Clark Regional Emergency Services Agency (CRESA)
contacts.notes: Regional agency giving emergency management to Clark County and its cities. 360-737-1911 is CRESA's general contact line from cresa.wa.gov. The EMD list gives its EM Division line as 360-992-6286. Address from the EMD list.

contacts.name: Columbia County Emergency Management
contacts.notes: Separate from Walla Walla County. The same phone appears in the EMD statewide list.

contacts.name: Cowlitz County Department of Emergency Management
Douglas County Sheriff's Office - Emergency Management
contacts.address: 100 19th St NW, Suite A, East Wenatchee, WA 98802
contacts.notes: Emergency management is run by the Sheriff's Office. This is the Sheriff's non-emergency line. Separate from Chelan County, though the two share an LEPC. The EMD list gives 509-888-6809 for EM Operations.

contacts.name: Ferry County Emergency Management
contacts.notes: Main county number. The county page gives ext. 2508 for the Emergency Manager; the EMD list gives ext. 1112. The extension is left out because the sources disagree. No coordinates: Nominatim had no house-number match for this address (street-level results were rejected).

contacts.name: Franklin County Emergency Management
contacts.notes: Has its own office, not shared with Benton County. It is an interlocal agency serving Pasco, Connell, Kahlotus, Mesa and unincorporated Franklin County. The same phone appears in the EMD list.

contacts.name: Garfield County Emergency Management
contacts.notes: Phone from WA EMD Statewide EM Contact List dated 01 Nov 2026 (county site blocked automated access). Only a PO box is listed, so there are no coordinates. Garfield County Sheriff (non-emergency): 509-843-3494, 789 W Main St, Pomeroy.

contacts.name: Grant County Sheriff's Office - Emergency Management Division
contacts.notes: Phone and address from WA EMD Statewide EM Contact List dated 01 Nov 2026. The county website only lists the Sheriff's main line, 509-754-2011, and gives the Sheriff's Office address as 1890 Nat Washington Way SE, Ephrata. The office may have moved, so confirm the address.

contacts.name: Grays Harbor County Emergency Management
contacts.address: 310 W Spruce St, Suite 212, Montesano, WA 98563
contacts.notes: Part of the Sheriff's Office. The same phone and address appear in the EMD list. No coordinates: Nominatim had no house-number match for this address (street-level results were rejected).

contacts.name: Island County Department of Emergency Management
contacts.notes: Also reachable from Camano at 360-629-4523 ext. 7370 and South Whidbey at 360-321-5111 ext. 7370. The EMD list gives the duty officer as 360-679-7343.

contacts.name: Jefferson County Department of Emergency Management
contacts.notes: The same phone appears in the EMD list.

contacts.name: King County Office of Emergency Management
contacts.notes: Toll-free: 800-523-5044. Many King County cities run their own EM offices.

contacts.name: Kitsap County Department of Emergency Management
contacts.notes: Phone from WA EMD Statewide EM Contact List dated 01 Nov 2026 (several staff entries). Not shown on the kitsapdem.com homepage.

contacts.name: Kittitas County Sheriff's Office - Emergency Management
contacts.notes: This is the Sheriff's Office line; ask for an Emergency Management Specialist. Email: kcsoem@co.kittitas.wa.us. No coordinates: Nominatim had no house-number match for this address (street-level results were rejected).

contacts.name: Klickitat County Department of Emergency Management
contacts.notes: The county site lists 509-773-2460. The EMD list instead gives 509-773-4545 as the 24/7 contact. No coordinates: Nominatim had no house-number match for this address (street-level results were rejected).

contacts.name: Lewis County Emergency Management
contacts.notes: Serves unincorporated Lewis County and the cities of Chehalis, Morton, Mossyrock, Napavine, Toledo, Vader, Winlock and Pe Ell. Centralia is not on that list.

contacts.name: Lincoln County Sheriff's Office - Emergency Management
contacts.notes: The Sheriff serves as Emergency Manager. 509-725-3501 is the Sheriff's non-emergency and general line from the county site. The EMD list gives 509-725-9264.

contacts.name: Mason County Division of Emergency Management
contacts.address: 100 W Public Works Dr, Building 1, Shelton, WA 98584
contacts.notes: Phone from WA EMD Statewide EM Contact List dated 01 Nov 2026 (county site blocked automated access). Staff lines are 360-427-9670 ext. 800 and ext. 806. No coordinates: Nominatim had no house-number match for this address (street-level results were rejected).

contacts.name: Okanogan County Emergency Management
contacts.notes: The county site gives Room 107 and the EMD list gives Room 106. Sheriff non-emergency: 509-422-7232. No coordinates: Nominatim had no house-number match for this address (street-level results were rejected).

contacts.name: Pacific County Emergency Management Agency (PCEMA)
contacts.notes: Joint agency for unincorporated Pacific County and the cities of Ilwaco, Long Beach, Raymond and South Bend. The same phone appears in the EMD list.

contacts.name: Pend Oreille County Department of Emergency Management
contacts.notes: The county site lists 509-447-3731. The EMD list instead gives 509-447-3151. Mailing: PO Box 5035, Newport.

contacts.name: Pierce County Department of Emergency Management
contacts.address: 2501 S 35th St, Suite D, Tacoma, WA 98409
contacts.notes: Phone from WA EMD Statewide EM Contact List dated 01 Nov 2026 (county site blocked automated access). EOC email: pceoc@piercecountywa.gov.

contacts.name: San Juan County / Town of Friday Harbor Department of Emergency Management
contacts.notes: Combined county and town office. The phone is the DEM Director's listed line (county directory and EMD list); no separate general line was found. The street address is from the EMD list, which also gives 260 West St, 2nd Floor, so confirm it.

contacts.name: Skagit County Department of Emergency Management
contacts.address: 2911 E College Way, Suite B, Mount Vernon, WA 98273
contacts.notes: Also serves Anacortes, Burlington, Concrete, Hamilton, La Conner, Lyman, Mount Vernon and Sedro-Woolley.

contacts.name: Skamania County Department of Emergency Management
contacts.notes: Phone from WA EMD Statewide EM Contact List dated 01 Nov 2026 (county site blocked automated access). A department within the Sheriff's Office. Mailing: PO Box 790, Stevenson.

contacts.name: Snohomish County Department of Emergency Management
contacts.address: 720 80th St SW, Building A, Everett, WA 98203
contacts.notes: After-hours duty line: 425-320-9189.

contacts.name: Spokane County Emergency Management
contacts.notes: Phone from WA EMD Statewide EM Contact List dated 01 Nov 2026 ('Co Main'); the same list also gives 509-477-3009. County site blocked automated access, and the website is the county homepage, not a verified EM page. The City of Spokane has its own separate OEM.

contacts.name: Stevens County Emergency Management
contacts.notes: Phone from WA EMD Statewide EM Contact List dated 01 Nov 2026 (county site blocked automated access). The website is the county homepage, not a verified EM page.

contacts.name: Wahkiakum County Emergency Management
